h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bahraich

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bahraich

items.pText: Bahraich lies in the Terai belt of Uttar Pradesh, close to the Nepal border, where the ground is flat, the soil is soft and the Ghaghara spreads wide in the rains. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, colleges, residential colonies and public gardens in Bahraich from our factory in Vasai, about 1,270 km away. Every order travels by road and is installed by our own team or a dealer in the region.

Soft, damp soil is the first thing we ask about when a Bahraich school sends an enquiry. Posts set straight into loose earth can tilt after one wet season, so we usually recommend grouting into a concrete base here. The play pieces themselves, galvanised steel frames and roto-moulded plastic slides and panels, are weather-proof and corrosion-resistant. Send us photos of the ground after rain if you can. They tell us more about drainage than a dry-season picture.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Building a firm base on soft Terai soil

c: On low ground that stays wet for weeks, raise the play area above the surrounding level with compacted fill before anything is installed. Give it a gentle slope towards one side and keep a drain or soak pit at that edge. Grouted posts then sit in concrete instead of mud.
Lay rubber flooring over a firm, levelled base under swings and slides. Grass under play equipment wears into bare patches within months, and those patches hold water. Our

items.q: Should playground posts be grouted on soft soil?
items.a: In most cases, yes. Grouting the posts into a concrete base keeps them upright on soft or damp soil. We confirm the method after looking at your site photos and the type of ground.

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment to Bahraich?
items.a: Yes. Equipment made at our Vasai factory is sent to Bahraich by road and installed by our team or a regional dealer, once you have approved the layout drawing and quote.

items.q: What surface works under swings on a wet site?
items.a: Rubber flooring on a raised, compacted base with a drainage slope. It cushions falls, drains off quickly and stays usable after heavy rain, which bare soil and grass do not.
